name: Crossroads Conscription
label: Quest
description: Crossroads Conscription directs newly enlisted Horde recruits from the border outpost into the heart of the Barrens. Carrying a signed letter from Kargal…
intro: Crossroads Conscription directs newly enlisted Horde recruits from the border outpost into the heart of the Barrens. Carrying a signed letter from Kargal Battlescar, adventurers report directly to Sergra Darkthorn at the vital strategic hub known as the Crossroads.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.
You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well well well, what do we have here? Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alright, friend. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.
